title: Do Modifications Made by Coding Agents Make Subsequent Software Maintenance Harder?
data:
R Pan, J Zhang, L Wu, Y Zhang, H Zhang, L Zhang- arXiv preprint arXiv:2610.14768, 2026
Coding agents increasingly maintain repositories over time, where each change 
becomes the starting point for subsequent tasks. Yet existing benchmarks either start 
tasks from developer-written code or cannot separate later-task difficulty from the 
effects of an agent's earlier changes. We ask whether agent-written code makes

title: Open Code, Hidden Collections: An Empirical Study of Academic Software Stewardship
data:
J Gomez, E Lovell, S Lieggi, J Davis, A Cardenas- Proceedings of the 26th ACM/IEEE, 2026
Academic institutions produce a substantial and growing digital collection of open 
source software artifacts, yet these repositories often lack the metadata, licensing,
